title: Not bad but not great for traveling
text:
Not bad but not great for traveling. Maybe my hopes were too high for these. I bought the for an upcoming 2 week international trip. One bag off the bat must have had a small hole in it because air got in no matter whay we did.

My observations:
You need to spend a lot if time fiddling with this, more time than I wanted to really. Different materials of the clothes you put in the bag some deflate better than others ir at different rates, the arrangement of the garments in the bag will change the outcome, the technique you use to get the air out of the bottom, etc. Since the main technique is to roll the bag you end up with a big lump at the bottom of the bag where youve pushed clothes to because past halfway the roll really doesn't work. We found a two person approach the best with one walking or kinda rolling/sliding on their knees from top of the bag to the bottom with the other kinda of guiding the air out to be best. You save the most space with sweaters and sweatshirts.

Honestly, for travel, the couple inches you save with this over layering or rolling your clothes is minimal. I probably will not use again for travel. Might use for blanket storage or something like that.
